system.name: Asif Hasan
system.subtitle: Graduate researcher at East West University focusing on Explainable AI for IoT cybersecurity, deep learning, and distributed network architectures.

education.degree: M.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering
education.focus: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI), IoT Intrusion Detection, and Deep Neural Networks.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering
education.focus: Core Theoretical Computer Science, Machine Learning, Operating Systems, and Distributed Networks.

publications.title: Ensemble Deep Learning for Enhanced Detection and Classification of Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease
publications.venue: International Conference on Data Mining and Information Security (ICDMIS 2024)
publications.series: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems (LNNS)
publications.abstract: This study addresses the critical pediatric diagnostic challenge of accurately detecting Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD). Evaluates deep convolutional architectures and implements an ensemble voting pipeline to significantly improve classification accuracy and robustness against noise in dermatological imaging.

publications.title: Classification of Peptic Ulcer and Digestive Tract Disorders Using Endoscopic Images
publications.venue: International Conference on Data Mining and Information Security (ICDMIS 2024)
publications.series: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems (LNNS)
publications.abstract: Presents an automated diagnostic pipeline for examining gastrointestinal tract endoscopy frames. Implements fine-tuned transfer learning backbones with targeted feature extraction to assist clinical specialists in identifying peptic ulcers and gastrointestinal abnormalities with high sensitivity.

publications.title: Rose Disease Detection Using YOLO: A Deep Learning-Based Approach
publications.venue: 9th International Conference on Information and Communication Technology for Competitive Strategies (ICTCS 2024)
publications.series: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems (LNNS)
publications.abstract: Deploys single-stage real-time object detection models (YOLO) for early botanical pathology identification. Accurately segments and classifies foliar rose diseases in natural field conditions to mitigate agricultural yield reduction.

publications.title: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) for IoT Intrusion Detection in Edge Gateways
publications.venue: East West University — Department of CSE (Active Thesis)
publications.abstract: Active M.Sc. thesis research developing lightweight, transparent tree ensembles and deep neural networks with SHAP/LIME attribution pipelines for real-time cyberattack detection on resource-constrained IoT gateways.

projects.title: EWU_MIND: AI-Driven News Recommendation System
projects.description: Personalized neural recommendation engine combining collaborative filtering with content embeddings to deliver low-latency, accurate ranking across large-scale news reader datasets.

projects.title: AI-Based Chess Engine
projects.description: Autonomous competitive chess engine implementing Deep Q-Networks and Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) to iteratively optimize positional evaluation and tactical move selections.

projects.title: ASICoin: Blockchain Cryptocurrency with AI Fraud Detection
projects.description: Cryptocurrency implementation exploring distributed consensus, cryptographic transaction validation, and AI-assisted anomaly detection for future-proof ledger protection.

projects.title: The ONE DTN Routing Protocol Simulator Extension
projects.description: Extensive empirical simulation benchmarking Epidemic, PRoPHET, and Spray-and-Wait delay-tolerant routing protocols across partitioned, intermittent networks during emergency disasters.

projects.title: Medicine Shop Inventory Management System
projects.description: Production database software managing pharmaceutical stock, real-time invoicing, point-of-sale audits, and automated expiry date tracking.

projects.title: Cryptocurrency Price Prediction via Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: Multimodal time-series forecasting model combining historical price movements with NLP sentiment embeddings extracted from financial news streams.
